prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Carousel Layout Refresh: Displays path options in a horizontal carousel layout with visual cards for comparing companion playstyles.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel"}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Audio Voice Interactive Flow: Adds an interactive sound choice experience on the pet selection screen where pets react with voice audio clips when picked.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_voice", "action": "play", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Desktop Launch Welcome Flow: Introduces an interactive mascot launch sequence and prompt button to kick off desktop pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "action": "next", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Launch Companion", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Launch Notification: Displays an active desktop system notification alert as soon as the pet preparation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!"}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Accessories New Screen: Adds a new pet customization screen ('new_accessories') in the adoption flow to customize colors and starter accessories.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_accessories", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_accessories": {"headline": "Customize Pet Accessories", "layout": "grid", "button_label": "Save & Continue"}}
5: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Cloud Pet Sync Redesign: Redesigns sign-in options to highlight cloud pet persistence and automatic account save indicators.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Pet Persistence Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Preparation Progress Details: Renders real-time stage progress text and time estimates during background pet habitat rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Companion Selection Interactive Flow: Adds an interactive preview component to test play styles directly within the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:path_preview", "action": "choose", "style": "rounded"}]}}
8: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Interactive Choice Cards Redesign: Replaces path options with interactive card components that emphasize companion personality traits.
   config: {"choose_path": {"replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Companion Playstyle", "style": "playful"}]}}}
9: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Choice Layout Refresh: Changes the pick friend pet selection layout to a multi-column grid for side-by-side companion comparison.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid"}}
